verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a scriptable CLI with JSON output and only per-ID commands such as `signals update <signal-id>`. There is no documented bulk or batch operation, such as bulk-triaging issues or updating many signals in one action. Looping the CLI in a script is a user-side workaround. Signal backfill and failure clustering are adjacent features, not user-driven bulk operations, so none of this earns credit.
